title: Artisans of Splendent Vale
subtitle: Cooperative storybook adventure with individual character books and tactical action scenes
tagline: Craft legendary artifice, explore an enchanted valley, and protect the township of Splendence
loreSummary: You are skilled artisans living in the peaceful township of Splendence, carved into a valley transformed long ago by a falling crimson star. When mysterious disturbances threaten your homeland, you must set forth with your tools, materials, and specialized crafts to uncover ancient secrets and defend the vale.
keyFeatures: Individual character storybooks featuring unique narrative perspectives and crafting recipes
Engaging tactical action scenes resolved on grid-based encounter maps
Rich crafting economy utilizing rare materials gathered during valley exploration
Branching narrative choices with interlude upgrades and persistent legacy progression

vale_standard.description: The complete narrative journey through the Splendent Vale, balancing exploration, character interludes, and tactical action scenes.

vale_master_artisans.description: Exhaustive campaign exploration uncovering all optional crafting blueprints, character lore interludes, and hidden vale locations.

milestones.title: Secrets of the Wilds

milestones.description: Uniting artisan crafts and ancient valley lore in a climactic tactical battle to safeguard the township and heal the land.
